summary: At segment 0 step 118, JavaScript refuses to loot an unlocked floor bag of tricks. C pickup.c:do_loot_cont() marks it known, prints the bite, draws rnd(10), applies Maybe_Half_Phys() through losehp(), identifies the object, aborts further looting, and spends a turn.

source.branch: When do_loot_cont() receives an unlocked floor container whose otyp is BAG_OF_TRICKS, it takes the dedicated bite branch before use_container().
callers: pickup.c:doloot() reaches do_loot_cont() through doloot_core() for the one-container and selected-container floor paths (2262, 2279).
js/pickup.js:doloot_core() already awaits do_loot_cont() in the corresponding floor paths (3606, 3622, 3670).

evidence: The saved v66 evaluation at 979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e reports 118/160 screens, 2078/2100 RNG calls, and 118/160 cursors matched; its first stop is the unsupported BAG_OF_TRICKS branch at step 118. Fresh scan at 4162c0e0b4f4d4b16edf61ae67a6a60c220bf8b0, wrapper run run-eVufmj, stops at 118 emitted screens after “You carefully open the bag of tricks...” with the UnsupportedPickupError from js/pickup.js:do_loot_cont(). Saved scan: .cache/a2-v66-floor-loot-scan.json.

Upstream pickup.c:do_loot_cont() (2088-2162) sets cobj->lknown, prints the opening and bite messages, evaluates rnd(10), passes Maybe_Half_Phys(tmp) to losehp(), calls makeknown(BAG_OF_TRICKS), sets ga.abort_looting, and returns ECMD_TIME. hack.h:1236 defines physical damage adjustment as ceiling(damage / 2) when Half_physical_damage is active; hack.h:1530 maps makeknown(x) to discover_object(x, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE).

JavaScript pickup.js:do_loot_cont() already reaches this branch through doloot_core(), but throws UnsupportedPickupError before the bite message, RNG draw, damage, object discovery, or abort state update. Existing losehp() and discover_object() provide the source callees.
